articles.title: Return window and eligibility
articles.body: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in original condition. Electronics have a 15-day window. Final-sale, personalized, and perishable items cannot be returned.

articles.title: How returns are shipped
articles.body: We email a prepaid return label as soon as a return is approved. Drop the parcel at any carrier point within 7 days, or schedule a doorstep pickup from the return page.

articles.title: Refund timelines
articles.body: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 3-5 business days of the returned item being scanned by the carrier. Bank posting can add 2-3 business days.

articles.title: Standard delivery timeframes
articles.body: Standard delivery is 3-6 business days, express is 1-2 business days. Orders placed after 6pm local time begin processing the next business day.

articles.title: Delayed or stuck shipments
articles.body: If tracking has not updated for 48 hours we open a carrier trace. Traces resolve within 3 business days; if the parcel is not located we reship or refund in full.

articles.title: Payments and authorization holds
articles.body: An authorization hold is placed at checkout and released within 5 business days if the order is cancelled. Duplicate authorizations drop off automatically and are never captured.

articles.title: Account and address changes
articles.body: Shipping addresses can be edited while an order is in processing. Once an order ships, the address is locked and must be redirected through the carrier.

articles.title: Warranty on electronics
articles.body: Electronics include a 12-month manufacturer warranty covering defects. Accidental damage is not covered. Warranty claims require the order ID and a photo of the item.
